filterType.description:
The type of filter to display.
- "multiselect": Allows multiple selections with checkboxes
- "singleselect": Allows single selection with dropdown
- "number": Allows numeric filtering with comparison operators

label.description: The display label for the filter. Can be a translation key.

dataId.description:
The data ID to fetch filter options from. This is the data ID for the data store with id
{@link UiApFilterBar#dataStoreId}. It should correspond to an entry in the {@link UiApDataStore#actionMap}.

Required for multiselect and singleselect filters. Ensure that the data store has an action
specific for this data ID if pagination and searching are required. The action should either return
a list of strings or utilize a {@link FetchSpec} to fetch the data. If strings are not returned and
a {@link FetchSpec} is not used, the filter will not function as expected.

dataPath.description:
The path within the data to access the filter options.
Defaults to the root data if not specified. Only applicable for multiselect and singleselect filters.

itemLabelPath.description:
The path to the field to use as the display label for each option.
Defaults to the data item itself if not specified.

itemIdPath.description:
The path to the field to use as the unique identifier for each option.
Defaults to the data item itself if not specified.

itemSecondaryLabelPath.description: The path to a secondary label field for additional display information.

title: Configuration for a single filter in the filter bar.
name: UiApFilterBar.FilterConfig
